name: Jack Tibbetts

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Tibbetts lists his occupation as farmer and small business owner, with a background in non-profit management and as a natural resource business owner.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Farmer, Small Business Owner Occupational Background: Non-Profit Management, Natural Resource Business Owner

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 39

positions.statement: Tibbetts says he would oppose new taxes and fees that he says raise the cost of living.

collection_notes: Statement is the LEFT column of Book4 p. 39 (Ticer is the right column). Pamphlet spells 'Freinds of Gap Road' and 'Ken Jakola' (inventory has a separate candidate id ken-jackola, probably the same Lebanon mayor; spelling kept as printed). Environment limit: WebFetch reaches only .gov hosts (news/third-party hosts fail with ENOTFOUND), so steps 3, 5 and 6 produced no fetched material; steps 4-5 searches were run for every candidate in SD3-SD11 with identical queries. Items are pamphlet-only (T1). Incumbent left null (no official page stating it).
